committees.name: Western and Southern Area Planning Committee

committee_papers.note: Committee ids confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-29. The pre-2019 district and county planning committees and the interim committee (419) are marked expired. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: P/TYPE/YYYY/NNNNN, with the type second (FUL, HOU, LBC seen). Taken from PlanIt's applics records on 2026-09-29.

quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'CCED'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

pacing.note: Five requests to the portal host on 2026-09-29, each answered with the maintenance page.

robots.note: Could not be read: robots.txt returned the maintenance page (HTTP 404) during the planned outage. Re-check when the site is back.

endpoints.note: PlanIt's applics records give detail pages at https://planning.dorsetcouncil.gov.uk/plandisp.aspx?recno=<n> (an internal record number, not the reference). Not fingerprinted: the site was down for maintenance throughout the 2026-09-29 run.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 302; no vendor fingerprint matched; WAF signals: cloudflare

Not tested. Every request to planning.dorsetcouncil.gov.uk (at 09:22, 12:05 and 12:45 UTC) returned HTTP 404 with a Cloudflare-served 'Website down for maintenance' page announcing an upgrade from 3pm on 28 September until 1pm on 29 September; it was still up 45 minutes after the advertised end. So no fingerprint, robots.txt or retrieval step was possible. Status and scriptable left as untested/null; no quirks dropped, since nothing was contradicted. PlanIt's applics records (one call) gave references and plandisp.aspx?recno= detail URLs, recorded above. Modern.gov GetCommittees (a separate host, up) checked for the committee ids. The upgrade may change the portal, so re-fingerprint before choosing a recipe.
